name: MISSING BACON: The Tower Update!
desc:
The legend is true... Bacon has been missing for years, but a
strange signal is coming from the top of this abandoned tower.
COULD HE STILL BE ALIVE? 🕵️
🥓 Find all 10 hidden Sad Bacons — each one gives a badge
🏗️ Climb the tower — NO checkpoints, one slip and you fall
🪙 Collect Coins and buy gear: Speed Coil, Gravity Coil,
   Hyper Laser Gun, Rainbow Carpet
🏆 Earn Wins to unlock the Ban Hammer
😈 Troll other players: Explode, Fling, Freeze
🎁 Free rewards just for playing
Can you reach the top and find out what happened to Bacon?
obby, tower, bacon, parkour, climbing, hard obby
